h1: Magento management, upkeep done for you
overview: This is a fixed starter sprint for Magento owners who would rather not do the upkeep. We review your store, apply the latest security patches where your version allows, clean up what looks wrong, then work through your list: product updates, new listings, order and stock checks, cache and index problems, and small fixes. You receive a short report. Ongoing monthly management is quoted separately.

faq: No. It is a one-time starter sprint at a fixed price. If you want us to keep going each month, we quote that separately with a written scope. Nothing renews on its own.
Do you apply Magento security patches?
Yes in Premium, first on a staging copy, then to the live store after your approval. In the smaller packages we review the status and tell you what is outstanding and how risky it is.
Can you add product listings in bulk?
Yes. Send a spreadsheet or product list with images and we create the products, categories and attributes. Counts are set by the package, and larger imports can be ordered through our other services.
Admin access to your Magento backend, as a separate admin user, and sometimes SSH or hosting access for patches. We never ask for your own passwords and you can remove our users when we finish.
